bots.name: R1 ⚠️OPTIMISTIC FILLS — Net is NOT money (~65% of its fills had no size behind them; obtainable-only is -0.07/tr, matching LIVE). Kept as the research baseline · 5m RELFLOOR (relative sigma floor — the fleet's BEST arm; keeps trading when vol collapses and absolute-floor arms go silent)

R4 ⚠️PRICE-ONLY FILL MODEL — checks the ask survived the flight but NOT that size existed; control for DEPTH · 5m RELFLOOR-REALISTIC (R1 + real fill rule: wait 600ms, re-read book, fill only if the ask survived — R1 minus R4 = the live discount)

L03 · 💵 5m BREADTH-3 PICK-ONE rel_frac=0.85 LIVE (0xE035; 6 coins, leaders first, 1 snipe/window, only windows where ≥3 coins signal; breadth is monotone in paper t=+5.70 AND in live fills; inherits R1 recal; NO capital floor)

TWIN ✅REALISTIC FILLS — Net is REAL (size-checked), NOT yet PROVEN — read n and t · L03 PAPER TWIN (same gates as LIVE + depth fill model; L03 minus TWIN = live execution cost; TWIN minus R1 = the fiction premium)

DEPTH ✅REALISTIC FILLS — Net is REAL (size-checked), NOT yet PROVEN — read n and t · 5m R1 + SIZE-CHECKING FILL (first paper arm whose PnL needs no obtainability filter; PREREG_depthfill review 09-17)
